# Helicro Transport

> Helicro Transport (Helicro SRL, VAT BE 0804.095.653) is a licensed private chauffeur and minivan transfer service based in Braine-l'Alleud, Belgium. It drives passengers between any Belgian address and Brussels Airport (Zaventem), Brussels South Charleroi Airport and Lille Airport at fixed prices agreed in advance, and also runs private day trips, corporate and embassy transport, festival and event transfers and same-day parcel delivery. Owner-driver Gerasimos has more than 30 years of accident-free driving and speaks English, French and Greek. Google rating 5.0 from 40 reviews.

## Key facts
- Vehicles: Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom minivans, up to 8 passengers and 8 large suitcases, air-conditioned, free child and booster seats.
- Fixed prices from Brussels city to Brussels Airport (Zaventem): 35€ for 1–2 passengers, 45€ for 3–4, 55€ for 5–8, per vehicle (Drop-off Area; P1 drop-off +5€).
- Fixed prices from Brussels city to Charleroi Airport: 65€ (1 passenger), 75€ (2), 90€ (3), 110€ (4), 120€ (5), 130€ (6), 140€ (7), 160€ (8), per vehicle, door to door.
- Private full-day sightseeing tour: from 380€ per vehicle.
- Live flight tracking, 60 minutes of free waiting after landing (then 30€/hour), meet and greet in arrivals with a name sign, no night surcharge, extra stops 10€.
- Free cancellation or changes up to 24 hours before pickup. Payment by card, bank transfer, invoice or cash.
- Available 24/7. Phone/WhatsApp +32 472 35 88 05 (Belgium) and +30 697 458 1706 (Greece). Email helicrotransport@gmail.com.
- Distances from Brussels: Zaventem 14 km (20–35 min), Charleroi Airport 60 km (55–70 min), Lille Airport 110 km (80–95 min).
